correctness.rationale: The connected-dominating subset cochain is an upper Boolean order ideal. Its quotient from the augmented full Boolean complex gives H^k(D)=reduced H^(k-2)(A). Independently constructed all connected-dominating cochain matrices and exact GF(2) ranks for every connected unlabelled graph in NetworkX Graph Atlas at orders 1..7: connected counts 1,1,2,6,21,112,853; zero-Euler counts 0,0,1,4,16,91,732; exactly one zero-Euler nonzero-cohomology exception (graph6 Fhf~o, 15 edges, Betti 2:1 and 3:1). This exhausts the known 1253-isomorphism atlas, not merely random samples. Examined frozen C all-edge-mask labeled enumerator: exact bitmask rank/structural checks would give 252; that C run was NOT repeated in this audit. Graph automorphism order 20 implies 7!/20=252 from one orbit. Witness A decomposes into disconnected point+S1 via five triangle free-edge collapses.
